architectureSummary.overview: FPM ONE is an enterprise digital church management and mobile engagement ecosystem built for Faith Preachers Ministry across multiple global branches. It consists of an Android native application, a responsive web Admin Portal, a secure REST API backend, and a PostgreSQL database with Row Level Security (RLS) and authoritative business logic functions.

androidApp.framework: Native Android with Jetpack Compose & Material 3
androidApp.architecturePattern: MVVM with Clean Architecture (Presentation, Domain/Repository, Data/Network, Security)
androidApp.networking: OkHttp 4.12.0 with JSON serialization and Bearer token interceptor
androidApp.biometrics: AndroidX BiometricPrompt hardware security challenge without storing raw biometric data

webAdminPortal.navigation: Single Page Application with 15 administrative modules
webAdminPortal.stateManagement: React Context (AuthContext) with Axios/Fetch REST client
features: Applicant approval queue with atomic worker code generation
Member directory with assignment editor and digital badge preview
Service schedule manager with grace periods and auto clock-out duration
Church event manager with RSVP tracking
Testimonies moderation queue with consent guard
Real-time attendance monitor with manual clock-out and excuse modal
Monthly attendance matrix report (Present, Late, Absent, Excused) with CSV export
webAdminPortal.hosting: Verified and running live on http://localhost:3000

backendApi.authentication: JWT Bearer tokens with bcrypt password hashing
backendApi.authorization: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) middleware verifying roles and administrative levels
scheduledWorkers: Auto clock-out background sweeper (configurable threshold, default 4 hours)
Automated absence marker for mandatory weekly services
backendApi.testSuite: Automated test suite (backend/src/test.ts) covering 30 exhaustive scenarios - 30/30 PASSED
backendApi.hosting: Verified and running live on http://localhost:5000/api

databaseSchema.databaseType: PostgreSQL / Supabase with Row Level Security (RLS)

functionsAndProcedures.name: generate_worker_code()
functionsAndProcedures.purpose: Atomically queries existing codes and generates sequential identifier in format FPM-XXXX (e.g. FPM-0001, FPM-0002).

functionsAndProcedures.name: clock_in_worker(p_worker_id, p_service_id, p_clock_in_method, p_pin)
functionsAndProcedures.purpose: Enforces authoritative server timestamp (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), checks duplicate clock-in lock for the same service and date, dynamically calculates Present vs Late using service grace period, and inserts attendance record.

functionsAndProcedures.name: auto_clock_out_workers()
functionsAndProcedures.purpose: Identifies active clock-ins exceeding configured service duration (default 4 hours), calculates duration minutes, and marks is_auto_clock_out = true.

functionsAndProcedures.name: mark_absent_workers(p_service_id, p_date)
functionsAndProcedures.purpose: Identifies active workers assigned to the service branch who did not clock in or submit an excuse, inserting status = 'absent'.

functionsAndProcedures.name: approve_member_account(p_user_id, p_admin_id, p_department_id, p_position_name)
functionsAndProcedures.purpose: Atomically updates account_status from pending_approval to active, generates sequential worker code if applicable, provisions worker_profile, and records audit log.

keyEnforcedBusinessRules.implementation: Attendance timestamps are generated strictly by server SQL CURRENT_TIMESTAMP. Client clocks are ignored.
Database unique constraint on (worker_id, service_id, service_date) rejects repeated attempts with 409 Conflict.
AndroidX BiometricPrompt hardware challenge. No raw fingerprint or face data is ever stored or transmitted.
Services define grace periods (default 15 mins). Clock-in within grace is marked Present; beyond is marked Late.
Scheduled worker terminates open clock-in sessions exceeding configured duration (default 4 hours), setting is_auto_clock_out = true.

keyEnforcedBusinessRules.rule: Multi-Step Registration Ending in Pending Approval
keyEnforcedBusinessRules.implementation: 4-step wizard ending in pending_approval state requiring pastoral leadership authorization before access is granted.

Account Status (active/pending/suspended), Ministry Role (Pastor/Elder/Worker/Member), Department (Media/Choir/Ushering), and Position (Broadcast Director/Camera Lead) are distinct relational entities.
Testimonies are held in moderation queue until pastor approves, and require member publication consent before public broadcast.
